decisions.reason: After surviving its first review year, this carpet now carries additional sunk design and marketing costs and a visible public commitment, so management would likely keep it unless overlap in the carpet range again prompts rationalization.

The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet strongly matches the firm's craftsmanship and premium-material identity, and continued support makes it easier for management to justify the original launch investment.

Management is still inclined to continue this publicly introduced carpet because it has already been retained once, though its similarity to other low-pile carpets keeps withdrawal risk somewhat higher than for more distinctive products.
The corner bench builds directly on the firm's established furniture business and project-oriented interiors, so accumulated commitment and strategic fit favor keeping it on the market.

A multi-model swivel shell chair line represents broader investment and stronger public commitment, and its relevance to flexible workplace concepts gives management strong reasons to continue backing it.
